title: Partial last page is missing from page count
body: With 21 records and a page size of 20, the response reports one page. It should report two so the last record is reachable.

title: Explicit zero retries falls back to three
body: Setting retries to zero still retries failed jobs three times. Zero should disable retries; an omitted value should still default to three.

title: Session remains valid at its expiry timestamp
body: The session validator accepts a session when now equals expiresAt. Expiration is exclusive: at that instant the session must be rejected, while earlier timestamps remain valid.

title: Fractional page sizes pass validation
body: The list endpoint accepts a page size of 1.5. Only integers from 1 through 100 should be accepted. Existing rejection of values outside that range should remain.

title: Request logger includes authorization header
body: The request logger writes the Authorization header value to application logs. Redact that field before logging, preserve the method field, and avoid mutating the caller's request object.

title: Health probe accepts upstream HTTP errors
body: The configured health probe reports healthy on HTTP 500 whenever a body is returned. It should accept only successful HTTP responses. Keep the same URL, request method, and response body handling.

title: Delivery endpoint uses retired notification hostname
body: The notification provider moved its delivery endpoint from https://notify-old.example.invalid/events to https://notify-new.example.invalid/events. Deliveries still use the retired host and fail. Update the destination to https://notify-new.example.invalid/events, preserving the payload and POST method.
